malignant_labelled: YES — malignant epithelial cells labelled; pEpi* programs defined on them
method: TRAINED CLASSIFIER, inferCNV used only as a cross-check
method_detail: Classifier score >0.75 in tumour channels = malignant; <0.25 in normal channels = normal epithelium. ~95% of tumour-channel and 2% of normal-channel epithelium called malignant. ~11% of likely-malignant cells showed no substantial CNV (8% MMRp, 15% MMRd).
concordance: DISCORDANT — primary call is not CNV-based. ~11% of its malignant cells would likely fail Ma's inferCNV cutoffs.

method_detail: Immune-focused atlas (CyTOF + scRNA-seq + mfIHC). No inferCNV, no CopyKAT, no copy-number analysis anywhere in the text. 'Non-malignant' refers to sample provenance (normal pancreas specimens), NOT to cell-level calls.
concordance: UNUSABLE for a malignant-epithelial estimand without deriving labels yourself

concordance: PARTIALLY DISCORDANT — cluster-level proxy, not a per-cell threshold like Ma's
